source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-9

procedures.title: Steering coupling: remove and install
steps: Reconnect the transmission controls to the shift levers at the column bottom, if fitted.
Reconnect the battery ground cable.

specs.what: flexible coupling clearance (Chevrolet, Chevelle, Corvette; figure 16)

procedures.title: Steering gear: remove and install
steps: Removal: remove the nuts, lock washers and bolts at the steering coupling.
Remove the pitman arm nut and washer from the sector shaft and mark the arm's position on the shaft.
Pull the pitman arm with tool J-6632 (see figure 3 in the manual).
Remove the gear-to-frame fasteners and lift the gear out.
Installation: position the gear so the coupling seats properly on the steering shaft's flanged end; on the Corvette, fasten the gear to the frame with bolts, washers and nuts.
Keep the coupling clearance shown in figure 16 in the manual.
Refit the pitman arm on the removal marks with its washer and retaining nut.
Fasten the coupling to the column's flanged end with lock washers and nuts.

procedures.title: Sector shaft seal: replace (gear in car)
steps: Remove the pitman arm as described under steering gear adjustment.
Loosen the lash adjuster locknut and back the adjuster screw out several turns.
Remove the 3 cap screws holding the side cover to the gear.
Pull the side cover and sector shaft out of the housing together; do not separate them.
Hook or pry the old sector shaft seal out of the housing.
Grease the new seal with chassis grease and set it in the sector shaft bore.
Drive the seal home with a suitably sized socket or pipe and a soft hammer.
Refit the sector shaft and side cover, protecting the new seal from the shaft splines (a few wraps of tape over the splines works).
Fit a new side cover gasket, align the cover on the housing and install the cap screws.
Adjust the gear and refit the pitman arm as under Maintenance and Adjustments.
notes: The standard Corvette column resembles the automatic/floor-shift column of other models but has no shift tube.
